name: Fiendish Hospitality

source.title: Pathfinder Society Scenario #7-20: The Strings of Hell

disable: DC 14 Religion check (trained) to disrupt the unholy energy projecting from the statue, DC 17 Athletics check to knock the statue off balance Three total successes using either skill disables the hazard.
reset: The statue returns to its human visage once no creatures are in the courtyard and it resets after 1d4+1 rounds. Until it resets, a creature can destroy the statue with a DC 16 Athletics check check, permanently disabling the hazard.
routine: (two actions) For its first action, the statue uses handmaiden's command. With its second action, it makes a stony tentacle Strike at the closest target within range; if there are no targets, the trap instead uses handmaiden's command again.

items.name: Ordered Escort
items.text:
Trigger A non-devil triggers or disables the slamming door hazard

---
Effect The statue takes on the visage of a handmaiden devil as a wave of unholy energy washes over the courtyard. Each creature in the courtyard must succeed at a DC 17 Will save save or be Slowed 1 for as long as it remains in the courtyard. The trap then rolls initiative.

items.name: Handmaiden's Command
items.text:
The statue emits a supernaturally compelling command. Each creature in the courtyard must make a DC 17 Will save save, with results below.

Success The creature is unaffected.

Failure The creature is pulled 5 feet toward the statue.

Critical Failure The creature is pulled 5 feet toward the statue and must spend the first action on its next turn making a Step toward the statue.

text: A haunting voice from the statue of a woman in servant's garb calls out to those in sight, welcoming them to stay. The statue then changes to the image of a gylou devil.
